summary: First test run of PART 22 Power Monitoring (Chennai). Backend: existing 39 unit tests pass + new 31 E2E API tests via public URL all pass (all endpoints, formulas, expected demo alerts/abnormal rules, thresholds PUT w/ restore, sensor override w/ cleanup, 400/404/422 validation). Frontend /power: KPIs, zone pills, clear scope, table row select, Leaflet marker click -> scope + KPI update, hidden-count (1), alert tabs (4 overload / 11 abnormal), threshold save/invalid toast/defaults, What-If (temp ignored w/o switch, +30% with switch at 45C, reset, overload warning, 422 inline error, slider keyboard), baseline integrity, 5 scenario rows, 17 recommendations each with 'Why' + human-approval note, pipeline nav scroll + placeholders, 390px mobile no horizontal overflow. All core flows work; only minor UX issues.

minor.issue: Sorts sensor readings by ISO timestamp string; readings with different tz offsets (+00:00 vs +05:30) will be ordered incorrectly. Store a UTC datetime field and sort on it.

Readings older than the dataset end are accepted (201) but silently ignored in snapshots; and if the most recent stored reading is older, an earlier-but-newer-than-dataset one is never considered. Consider returning a flag/warning ('applied': false).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'AC Power Monitoring' (pipeline-step-power) while on /power#recommendations does not scroll to top (scrollY stays ~5720).

issues: Negative cost differences render as '₹-57,832' instead of '−₹57,832'
Recharts bar tooltip cursor uses default light grey (#ccc) background — bright block on dark theme; set cursor={{fill:'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)'}}
AC power rating input shows 4 decimals (2.3764) while baseline label shows 2.38 — round display
Legend box overlaps southern markers (Tambaram/Sholinganallur) at default zoom; consider fitBounds to located markers
